content.short: Vaults.fyi provides precise on-chain yield data to help users compare yields across Ethereum and L2 networks.
content.description: Vaults.fyi aggregates on-chain DeFi yield data to help users find and compare yields across Ethereum and L2 networks. The dataset covers yield sources, TVL, historical metrics, and exit options, all derived directly from on-chain sources. This approach supports the calculation of accurate APYs and provides a clearer view of each opportunity, enabling more informed yield comparisons across multiple protocols and chains. All data is sourced directly from on-chain activity to keep comparisons consistent and up-to-date.
content.meta: Vaults.fyi helps users find yields across Ethereum and L2s with on-chain yield data. Discover Vaults.fyi and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
